name: Tiesunlong Shen
headline: Faithful, interpretable reasoning for large language models and knowledge graphs, applied to quantum computing and AI-driven drug design.
bio: I am a **Research Fellow** at [Duke-NUS Medical School](https://www.duke-nus.edu.sg/) & [NUS CQT](https://www.quantumlah.org/) (advised by [Prof. Enrico Petretto](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=11xd4Z8AAAAJ&hl=en)) and [Nanyang Technological University](https://www.ntu.edu.sg/) (advised by [Prof. Erik Cambria](https://sentic.net/)).

My research focuses on **Large Language Model Reasoning**, **Knowledge Graph Question Answering**, and their applications in **Quantum Computing** and **AI-driven Drug Design**. I am particularly interested in developing faithful reasoning methods that enhance the interpretability and reliability of AI systems.

My first-author/corresponding-author work appears at **NeurIPS**, **AAAI**, **SIGIR**, **COLING** and **ICASSP** and in **Information Fusion** and **Information Sciences**; as a co-author I have contributed to papers at **ACM MM** and **ACL**.
